title: Kansas K9 trooper drone swarm

tellings.quote: Here's a K9 trooper from I'll be very quick. K9 trooper from Kansas. Uh he had these flo fly right over his head.

plain: Around 2019 or 2020, a police dog handler with the Kansas state troopers is said to have had a group of drones fly right over his head. Marik von Rennenkampff, a writer on national security, brings up the case, credited to someone named Doug Johnson, during a debate with a UFO skeptic. He uses it as an example of unexplained objects seen by trained officials.
